summary: Grilled the plan against the story ACs, the legacy-upgrade spec, decision 0028 (path boundary), decision 0005 (recurring findings), and the repository-escape recurring class on upgrade.py. Single bounded task, no over-build; every section traces to an AC.
gaps: Plan claimed 'No new decisions' while choosing the deterministic approach — a design stance that could warrant a decision record for traceability.

Original plan wrote <file>.orig for every diverged contract; operator flagged this bloats the client repo on every upgrade and is redundant, since upgrade requires a clean tree so the client's prior content is already committed and git-recoverable.
resolutions: Operator confirmed: rely on the recorded requirements grill + the confirmed legacy-upgrade spec; 'No new decisions' stands.

Dropped .orig entirely (operator-confirmed): truthful report + a divergence warning that names the overwritten-and-diverged contracts and points the operator at git diff before committing; git is the backup. No files written, no bloat. Roadmap AC2/AC3 and the plan reworded; the only remaining path-boundary surface is the read, guarded by is_file()/not is_symlink().
